title: StrategyConfigCreateRequest
description: Phase I-1b (operator-account-onboarding): input for the dark-gated create-tenant path. 'Create tenant' = INSERT the first strategy_config row for a new (tenant_id, strategy_id) at version 1 (Phase-0 DECISION: NO separate tenants table). The operator-scoped api-gateway POST /admin/tenants/{tenant}/strategies/{strategy} starts a short-lived StrategyConfigCreateWorkflow on orchestrator-core, synchronously reads its StrategyConfigCreateResult, and maps the outcome to an HTTP status. The activity drives StrategyConfigWriter.create(tenant, strategy, config, operator) — an INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING that fails-closed to ALREADY_EXISTS on a duplicate. DARK by default: the route 404s unless operator.tenant-create.enabled=true. Carries NO secret/key material — config is a plain StrategyConfig blob; broker keys flow through the separate credential write path.

schema_version.description: DTO contract version. See CopytradeSignalPayload.schema_version. Workers reject newer-than-build inputs.

tenant_id.description: Tenant being created. Taken from the api-gateway path (operator-scoped, NOT X-Tenant-Id — the operator does not belong to the new tenant). StrategyConfigWriter.create rejects a config whose tenant_id does not match this (REJECTED_INVALID).

strategy_id.description: Strategy whose first config row is the INSERT target for (tenant_id, strategy_id). A second create for the same key yields ALREADY_EXISTS, never a second row.

config.description: The full StrategyConfig blob to persist at version 1. Reuses the generated StrategyConfig DTO. StrategyConfigWriter validates it standalone (live-required gates apply ONLY when broker_target is live, so a paper create passes); a live create missing a loss gate is REJECTED_INVALID.

operator_id.description: The authenticated operator (X-Operator-Id). Recorded on the audit event and the strategy_config row's updated_by — operator attribution comes from the audit_log chain, not a created_by column.

correlation_id.description: OPTIONAL cross-event correlation key. Embedded in the workflow id so a retried api-gateway call dedups on REJECT_DUPLICATE rather than re-running the INSERT.

account_daily_loss_pct.description: PLAN-2026-08-05-direct-live-tenant-onboarding: OPTIONAL operator-supplied account-level daily-loss cap (fraction of start-of-day equity). When a LIVE strategy is created and the tenant has no armed cap yet, StrategyConfigWriter.create arms it — an unconditional INSERT into tenant_config (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING) BEFORE the strategy INSERT — so the live-required-gate (StrategyConfigInvariants.validateLiveRequiredGates: accountCapArmed = account_daily_loss_pct>0 OR account_daily_loss_threshold>0) passes in one operator action. Floored at TenantConfigWriter.MIN_ACCOUNT_DAILY_LOSS_PCT (0.05). Null/absent = no cap supplied → a live create with no pre-existing cap is still REJECTED_INVALID (unchanged); a paper create ignores it. The per-strategy StrategyConfig.daily_loss_threshold is a DEAD field and does NOT satisfy this gate.
